dedupe_keys.name: standard load profiles for district heating networks

description: This data set gives standard load profiles for residential district heating networks, calculated with a statistical method from measurement data of 30 networks as described in the research article on standard load profiles for district heating networks. It was published by Thilo Walser, and the file name marks it as a Solites product. The profiles are scaled to a residential network with a total heat demand of 50 GWh per year at the heating plant, for one operating year with average weather at Würzburg, Germany (test reference year 2015). Three versions cover medium, low and high base load, one per sheet, where base load is the average heat load at assigned ambient temperatures. Coverage is a generic German residential network at the resolution given in the sheets. The data are one XLSX workbook on Zenodo (version 1.0, April 2025) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: profiles represent residential networks under average weather at one location and need rescaling for other demands or climates. Simulation uses are sizing and dispatch studies of district heating plants and storage. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
